LIST.TITLE: Payment methods
LIST.SUBTITLE: Cash, card, and online providers your business accepts.
LIST.EMPTY: No methods yet — add one to get started.

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.TYPE_CASH_HINT: Currency wallet — one per accepted currency.
FORM.SYMBOL_HINT: Shown next to amounts at the POS and on receipts.
FORM.CURRENCY_HINT: Picking a currency auto-fills the name, symbol, and decimal precision.
FORM.RATE_HINT: Rate against the company base currency. 1 if this IS the base currency.
FORM.BANK_CHARGE_HINT: Processing fee charged by the bank/network for this method.
FORM.AFTER_DECIMAL_HINT: 0–3 — how many decimals to show for amounts on this method.
FORM.ACCOUNT_HINT: The accounting ledger this method posts to.
FORM.POS_SUB: How this method behaves at the register.
FORM.POS_ENABLED_HINT: When off, cashiers can't pick this method.
FORM.OPEN_DRAWER_HINT: Sends the open-drawer signal after a sale on this method.
FORM.REQ_CODE_HINT: Prompts the cashier for a reference (e.g. card last 4) before completing.
FORM.SHOW_IN_ACCOUNT_HINT: Surface this method as a wallet inside the Accounts module.
FORM.ERR_RATE_INVALID: Exchange rate must be greater than 0.

CONNECT.TITLE: Connect {{provider}}
CONNECT.SUBTITLE: Enter the credentials issued by {{provider}} so the storefront and POS can process payments through this provider.
CONNECT.ACCOUNT_HINT: Settlement deposits will post to this account.
CONNECT.ENABLED_HINT: Turn on once the credentials below are filled and tested.
CONNECT.APPLE_PAY_SUB: Optional — accept Apple Pay over this provider's gateway.
CONNECT.APPLE_PAY_ACTIVE_HINT: Turn on to enter Apple's merchant identifier and certificate.

FIELDS.MERCHANT_ID_HINT: Issued by the provider when your merchant account is provisioned.
FIELDS.API_PASSWORD_HINT: The API password matched with the merchant ID. Stored encrypted.
FIELDS.SECRET_KEY_HINT: Server-side key — never expose to the storefront client.
FIELDS.PUBLISHABLE_KEY_HINT: Client-side key — safe to embed on the storefront.
FIELDS.TOKEN_HINT: Long-lived API token issued by the provider.
FIELDS.APPLE_MERCHANT_IDENTIFIER_HINT: From Apple Developer → Identifiers → Merchant IDs.
FIELDS.APPLE_CODE_STRING_HINT: Paste the certificate code string issued by Apple.
FIELDS.APPLE_SECRET_KEY_HINT: Provider-issued secret for Apple Pay routing.
